question: How do you work with KOLs?
answer: Carefully. KOLs are putting their clinical reputation on the line every time they appear on camera, and they know it. They're busy, they're precise, and they're protective of how they're represented. We've learned how to earn that trust: how to brief them properly, how to get the best performance, and how to make sure the final content reflects well on them as well as on you. Your KOL relationships take years to build. We treat them accordingly.
